description: Per organisation type, the Woo information categories that do not apply to it, each with its legal basis. The basis is the scope the Woo article gives the category, as the TOOI list scw_woo_informatiecategorieen (version 4) records it in skos:definition. A category is only proposed where that text names the bodies it covers and the type is not among them; an entry that cannot be cited is left out. The administrator confirms or changes the proposal per category (REQ-WVL-004).
